summary:

Su Yun corrects him: two missions, the first trains specialists.

detailed_description:

The target video is a cinematic 1950s period drama, flat overcast daylight on the tank training ground — churned earth and rutted tracked-vehicle lanes, sparse dry grass, low hills and a flat pale overcast sky beyond, a few captured Japanese Type-97 Chi-Ha tanks crawling through their drill in the middle distance, pressing fresh track marks into the mud MEDIUM SHOT, two men. Su Yun at frame-RIGHT, the young factory director, a man, in a dark high-collared jacket, NEVER in a military uniform, shakes his head and corrects, his mouth clearly moving: <d>[Chinese]不只是培养。</d> He ticks it off: <d>[Chinese]是两个使命。</d> He states the first: <d>[Chinese]第一，为未来坦克、飞机、雷达、军舰潜艇，培训最专业士兵，不只开，还要懂原理。</d> Feng Zhenbang at frame-LEFT, in a plain military uniform with soft cap and round-frame glasses, both kept ON throughout, listens, chin lifted, turning it over. The camera HOLDS — no push, no drift. Every person in frame is a man; no woman appears anywhere. NO third figure, NO readable text.

**口型**：Su Yun (S2) speaks aloud, lips moving; Feng Zhenbang (S3) lips STILL and closed.

负面约束：无过曝死白、无纯黑死阴影、无锐化锯齿、无面部崩坏、无手部畸形／多指、无旗帜、无残留分镜箭头／时间码、无逻辑跳切、**眼睛绝不发光**、**无女性、画面里出现的每一个人都是男性**、无第三人入画。

overall_soundscape: one calm, deliberate correction, a slow thoughtful breath

non_diegetic_music: N/A
